Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Interface MulticastClientEventHandler

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    MulticastClientEventAdapter
    public interface MulticastClientEventHandler
    Defines event callbacks for monitoring the operation of a MulticastClient.

    Implementations may be registered with a multicast client to receive notifications for socket lifecycle events, multicast group membership, datagram sends, and agent communication events. Implementing this interface is optional and is not required for normal multicast client operation.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    MulticastClient, MulticastClientEventAdapter
